title: Domain expertise has always been the real moat
summary: This article argues that domain expertise, not AI technology itself, is the true competitive moat for businesses. The author explains that companies with deep industry knowledge can better leverage AI tools by understanding the nuances, workflows, and edge cases unique to their domain. The piece gained significant traction on Hacker News with 594 points and 351 comments, indicating strong resonance with the tech community.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that raw AI capability alone provides sustainable competitive advantage
why_valuable: It provides a strategic framework for startups and companies to focus on building deep domain expertise rather than competing solely on AI technology, which is more defensible long-term
